summary: Tested EPF band-based calculation, dynamic statutory recalculation, and '0' input deletion bug fix. All backend tests passed (13/13). Frontend UI tests verified: EPF amounts are whole RM (no cents), statutory deductions auto-calculate on dialog open and update dynamically when variable earnings change, number input fields can be cleared to empty (no stuck '0' bug).

issues: PWA install banner overlays bottom of page - minor annoyance but doesn't block functionality

seed_data_creation: EPF band data with 1001 records already exists in statutory_rates collection
context_for_next_testing_agent: EPF calculation now uses band-based lookup from statutory_rates collection (rate_type: 'epf') for salaries ≤RM20,000. EPF amounts are whole RM (no cents) per Malaysian Third Schedule. Employer rate is 13% for salary ≤RM5000 and 12% for >RM5000. Dynamic statutory recalculation works via POST /api/hr/statutory/calculate endpoint with 400ms debounce. The '0' input deletion bug was fixed using nv() helper for display and np() helper for onChange.
